# Fences

An unknown language:

```dhall-with-frills
let configuration = { enabled = True }
```

A diagram grammar:

```mermaid
graph TD;
  A-->B;
```

A fence whose content is itself markup:

```html
<script>window.__pwned = true;</script>
```

A fence with no language:

```
plain, unlabelled content
```

Inline `code with <b>tags</b> in it`.
